answer: Continuous work-rate escrow resists Sybil attacks: every identity must keep submitting small proofs of useful work to stay active, like a glacier that only moves while meltwater keeps flowing. A dormant alias freezes and loses weight, so an attacker cannot stockpile a dune of idle fakes and unleash them at once; each live fake needs its own steady stream of compute, like a ferrous anchor chain forged link by link. Honest agents pay one stream; a swarm pays a thousand, and its cost grows with every fake it keeps alive.
